verdict.rationale: AWS publishes downloadable, machine-readable Smithy JSON AST models "for all public AWS API services" in the official aws/api-models-aws repository, and botocore per-service service-2.json files carry the same models. These qualify as an OpenAPI-equivalent spec. The probe finding no OpenAPI file on the docs host does not contradict this. missing for 10: native OpenAPI format (Smithy/botocore JSON need conversion), discoverability from the docs host rather than GitHub only, an actively monitored canonical spec source (the repo says it "is not closely monitored"), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
